players.injury_comment: Curry told reporters after Friday's loss to the Grizzlies that he will "probably not" play against the Suns on Saturday, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.
Irving posted 24 points (8-15 FG, 5-10 3Pt, 3-3 FT), one rebound, three assists, one block and one steal over 25 minutes before fouling out of Friday's 121-105 win over Indiana.
